_about: The consumables the wiki shows and what they do in numbers (tools/build_wiki.py folds them into data/wiki.json with the game's text, icon, rarity and recipes from data/raw/items.json). Curated 2026-10-13. Numbers from the game data: data/datamine/PlayerItemParam.json (dtlnor/MHWs-in-json; internal names: Kijin = Demon, Kouka = Armor/Hardshell, Kairiki = Might, Nintai = Adamant, Kanpou = Herbal, Elixir = Max Potion, _G = the stronger version). Stacking from game8 (archives/501955), Fextralife item pages and Steam tests. boost and duration are the short forms for the overview tables. confidence: high = game data and the game's text or a community test agree, medium = game data whose meaning is inferred or one secondary source, low = unverified.

categories.title: Attack
categories.about: Three separate boosts that add up: a drink (Demondrug or Mega Demondrug, the Mega one replaces the other), a seed or pill (Might Seed or Might Pill, only the higher counts; the Xu Wu set bonus Protein Fiend shares this slot) and Demon Powder. The Powercharm counts on top of all of them, as does a meal's attack. Best stack: Mega Demondrug + Might Seed + Demon Powder + Powercharm = +33.

categories.title: Defense
categories.about: The same pattern as attack: a drink (Armorskin or Mega Armorskin), a seed or pill (Adamant Seed or Adamant Pill), Hardshell Powder, and the Armorcharm on top.

categories.title: Healing
categories.about: Potions heal part at once and the rest over a few seconds. Max and Ancient Potions also raise the health gauge to its maximum for 15 minutes.

categories.title: Food and stamina
categories.about: Food raises the stamina (and for steaks the health) gauge. A Ration is also what the Portable BBQ Grill cooks a meal from: see Meals.

categories.title: Cures and climate
categories.about: Blight cures and the hot / cold area drinks. A Sizzling Meal skill makes the drinks unnecessary.

categories.title: Materials
categories.about: What the items above are made from: where to gather, retrieve, buy or carve each one, and what else it goes into.

Demondrug.stacking: Stacks with Might Seed / Might Pill, Demon Powder, the Powercharm and meal attack. Not with Mega Demondrug: the stronger drink replaces it.
notes: Fextralife says the effect persists through fainting; one Steam user says only the Mega version does. Unconfirmed.
Demondrug.source: PlayerItemParam _KijinDrink_AddAttack 5, _KijinDrink_Time 1800 s; stacking: Fextralife, Steam tests

Mega Demondrug.stacking: Stacks with Might Seed / Might Pill, Demon Powder, the Powercharm and meal attack. Replaces a Demondrug's +5 rather than adding to it.
notes: Some guides say +10: the game data says +7.

Might Seed.stacking: Shares one boost with Might Pill and the Protein Fiend set bonus (Xu Wu's Vigor): only the highest applies. While a Might Pill runs, the seed's +10 is suspended and comes back when the pill ends, if the seed's own 3 minutes are not over. Stacks with the Demondrugs, Demon Powder and the Powercharm.
Might Seed.source: PlayerItemParam _Kairiki_AddAttack 10, _Kairiki_Time 180 s; stacking: game8 501955, Fextralife Might Pill

Might Pill.stacking: Overrides a Might Seed (and Protein Fiend) while it runs: only the highest of the three applies. Stacks with the Demondrugs, Demon Powder and the Powercharm.
notes: Guides say 20 seconds; the game data says 21.

effects: Attack +10 for 3 minutes, for you and every hunter nearby
Demon Powder.stacking: Reported to stack with Might Seed / Might Pill, the Demondrugs and the Powercharm (community reports, no status-screen test found). Demon Ammo gives the same +10; whether the two add up is unknown.
notes: EZ Demon Powder (handed out on some quests) gives the same boost.

obtain: A reward for one of two optional high rank quests at Wounded Hollow (from chapter 4): Rex's hunt of two Ajarakan and Cobb's hunt of two Hirabami give the Powercharm and the Armorcharm between them. It cannot be crafted or bought.
effects: Attack +6 as long as it is in your item pouch
notes: Matches the status screen (checked 2026-10-08). The optimizer counts it by default ("Powercharm in the pouch" under Conditions).

Armorskin.stacking: Stacks with Adamant Seed / Pill, Hardshell Powder and the Armorcharm. Not with Mega Armorskin: the stronger drink replaces it.
notes: Fextralife says the effect persists through fainting. Unconfirmed.

Mega Armorskin.stacking: Stacks with Adamant Seed / Pill, Hardshell Powder and the Armorcharm. Replaces an Armorskin's +15.

Adamant Seed.stacking: Presumably shares one boost with the Adamant Pill like Might Seed and Might Pill do (not confirmed). Stacks with the Armorskins, Hardshell Powder and the Armorcharm.

Adamant Pill.stacking: A multiplier, not a flat bonus. Presumably overrides an Adamant Seed while it runs (not confirmed).
notes: A Steam user timed it at about 2:15; unexplained.

effects: Defense +20 for 3 minutes, for you and every hunter nearby
Hardshell Powder.stacking: Stacks with the Armorskins, Adamant Seed / Pill and the Armorcharm (by analogy with Demon Powder).
notes: Armor Ammo gives the same +20 for 3 minutes.
